data_points.source_name: MFDS (Ministry of Food and Drug Safety) press release, '24년 화장품 생산·수출액 모두 사상 최대실적 기록 (2025-05-27)
data_points.notes: PRODUCTION VALUE, not retail and not export. MFDS annex table 3 화장품 유형별 생산실적: 방향용 제품류 (fragrance product type) KRW 680억 in 2024 (= KRW 68.0bn; USD 46.0mn @ 1478.40 USD/KRW pinned 2026-07-21 in config/exchange_rates.yaml), 0.4% of total cosmetics production of KRW 175,426억. 2023 comparator KRW 593억. SCOPE CAVEAT: MFDS 방향용 covers only cosmetics-registered fragrance product types manufactured in Korea; it excludes imported fragrance (Korea's fragrance market is import-dominated), so this is NOT a proxy for domestic fragrance retail demand. cf IMARC retail-basis USD 792.5mn (2025) — ~17x the production figure, which is a basis + import-coverage difference, not a conflict; do not compare directly.

data_points.methodology: Computed from the two adjacent-year values printed in MFDS annex table 3 for 방향용 제품류: KRW 593억 (2023) to KRW 680억 (2024) = +14.67%. Both values are on the same PRODUCTION basis from the same official table, so no normalisation is needed. The MFDS release does not itself print a YoY % for this product type (it prints +20.9% only for the all-cosmetics total). Sensitivity: none on the arithmetic; the uncertainty is definitional (domestic production only, excludes imports), not numerical.
data_points.notes: Korean domestic fragrance PRODUCTION growth CY2024. Not a retail demand growth rate. All-cosmetics production grew +20.9% over the same period, so fragrance production grew materially slower than the category.

'The South Korea perfume market size reached USD 792.5 Million in 2025.' SCOPE CAVEAT: scope is 'perfume', which may be narrower than the full fragrances segment (fine fragrance only, excluding body mists/home fragrance); channel coverage and duty-free inclusion not stated on the page — see CLAUDE.md rule 12, duty-free is a distinct Korean channel and IMARC does not say whether it is in or out. cf Expert Market Research USD 485.19mn for the same geography and same year 2025 — 1.63x gap, definitional mismatch unresolved (IMARC says 'perfume', EMR says 'fragrances and perfume', so the wider-scope source is the SMALLER number, which rules out a simple scope explanation); do not average. NOTE: a search snippet circulated USD 754.71mn for this same IMARC page; the page as actually fetched on 2026-07-25 states USD 792.5mn, and the fetched value is the one recorded.
IMARC: USD 792.5mn (2025) to USD 1,204.3mn (2034), CAGR 4.62% during 2026-2034. Trajectory is internally consistent (792.5 x 1.0462^9 = 1,192, within rounding of 1,204.3).

'The South Korea fragrances and perfume market reached a value of USD 485.19 Million at 2025.' cf IMARC USD 792.5mn for the same geography and same year 2025 — 1.63x gap, definitional mismatch unresolved, do not average. Perverse direction: EMR's stated scope ('fragrances and perfume') is WIDER than IMARC's ('perfume') yet its number is lower, so the gap is not explained by scope breadth. Channel coverage and duty-free treatment not stated by either (CLAUDE.md rule 12). Both are aggregator teasers with no published methodology; neither should be used as a headline Korea fragrance market size without a Euromonitor or MFDS/KOSIS cross-check.

EMR: USD 485.19mn (2025) to USD 893.81mn (2035), CAGR around 6.30% over 2026-2035. Trajectory is internally consistent (485.19 x 1.063^10 = 894). cf IMARC 4.62% (2026-2034) and SPER 5.2% (2023-2028) — the three aggregators disagree on level AND on pace; EMR forecasts ~36% faster growth than IMARC. Record all, do not blend.

'market is expected to increase at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of around 5.2% from 2023 to 2028.' Recorded because its period is explicitly stated; sits between IMARC 4.62% and EMR 6.30%. WARNING — the rest of this page is internally inconsistent and its LEVEL figures are therefore NOT recorded as claims: the same page states the market generated 'around $1.2 billion in sales in 2022' yet is 'projected to be worth USD 834.59 million by 2033' at a claimed 5.49% CAGR, which is arithmetically impossible (a 5.49% CAGR from $1.2bn would give ~$2.1bn by 2033, and the stated endpoint is below the stated start). Treat SPER's Korea fragrance levels as unreliable. Note also its $1.2bn (2022) is 1.5x IMARC's USD 792.5mn (2025) and 2.5x EMR's USD 485.19mn (2025) — the three-way level dispersion across aggregators for this segment is roughly 2.5x, which is why no headline Korea fragrance market size should be published off aggregators alone.
